logline: Under Penn Square Garden, after the fight: two strangers who were on opposite sides of an envelope an hour ago.

shots.framing: The 1968 concourse: low ceiling, fluorescent strips, a shuttered newsstand
shots.blocking: Teddy and Delphine burst through the Eighth Ave doors and slow to a walk
beats: Fireworks thud far above, through concrete
shots.notes: audio: distant fireworks; a train announcement, muffled | lighting: cold fluorescent; one tube flickering | film: grain; slight overexposure on the tubes

shots.framing: Both against a tiled pillar, breathing
shots.blocking: Teddy pats his jacket for the envelopes

shots.framing: Delphine, half-smile, eyes on the stairs behind him
Teddy, a laugh that doesn't make it out
The envelope with her fifty, in his hand between them
beats: The choice c1 is untimed; the envelope holds frame

shots.framing: The two of them small in the long concourse
shots.blocking: They walk toward the Seventh Ave exit together
shots.notes: film: fade to the Act 2 title card: HEAT
